items.title: 9.8.3 How to Foster Innovation and Creativity

source_refs.note: Topic 9.8.3 with the class activity (PDF 222-223, printed 219-220). The Urdu-dictionary claim is carried as the book's statement and flagged; the canteen suggestion is illustrative.

items: Be curious: ask questions and explore how things work; curiosity is the first step to innovation.
Take risks: try new things even if they may fail at first; many innovations come from learning from failure.
Think outside the box: look at problems from different perspectives.
Collaborate: working with others sparks new ideas.

blocks.text: The book also states that the first online Urdu dictionary was developed by a Pakistani innovator (Did You Know); this claim is carried as printed.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: in groups, brainstorm creative solutions to a problem in your college or community and present them. Suggest one.
blocks.explanation: For example, for long canteen queues: a pre-order sheet or messaging group so food is ready at break time. This suggestion is illustrative.

items: Foster innovation: curiosity, risk-taking, new perspectives, collaboration.
